sources.name: Your right to request a decent broadband service
sources.coverage: UK legal right for homes and businesses to request a decent affordable broadband connection where qualifying service is unavailable
sources.access: Official guidance and eligibility route via BT/KCOM
sources.role: Hard-to-reach premises fallback and minimum-connectivity eligibility evidence
sources.limitations: Eligibility depends on available alternatives and provider assessment; it is not proof of current parcel service quality

sources.name: Broadband and mobile coverage checker
sources.coverage: Postcode-based fixed broadband availability and mobile coverage by provider across the UK
sources.update_cadence: Service refreshed from Ofcom coverage datasets; checker page last updated 25 June 2025
sources.access: Interactive postcode checker plus developer API
sources.role: High-value postcode-level availability precheck and provider-coverage evidence
sources.limitations: Coverage predictions are not live order guarantees and the checker does not report temporary maintenance or outages

sources.name: Broadband speeds: what you need to know
sources.coverage: Consumer protections on busy-time speed estimates, minimum guaranteed speeds and exit rights for participating providers
sources.update_cadence: Standing consumer guidance tied to Ofcom broadband speed codes
sources.role: Distinguishes advertised/available access from contracted performance guarantees
sources.limitations: Only applies to providers/signatories covered by the code and does not independently measure a parcel's connection

sources.name: Switching off the UK’s 2G and 3G mobile networks: what you need to know
sources.coverage: UK customer guidance on completed 3G switch-off and forthcoming 2G retirement
sources.role: Mobile-access continuity and legacy-device compatibility evidence
sources.limitations: Operator 2G timetables can change and this does not prove local 4G/5G service at a specific property

sources.name: Ofcom’s expectations of mobile providers for 2G and 3G switch-off
sources.coverage: Regulatory expectations on minimising coverage impact and supporting customers during legacy-network retirement
sources.role: Quality-control evidence for interpreting mobile transition risk
sources.limitations: Expectations and commitments do not constitute parcel-level coverage measurements

sources.name: Switching off 2G and 3G networks: advice for IoT and third-party device suppliers
sources.coverage: UK guidance for connected devices affected by completed 3G and future 2G switch-off
sources.role: IoT/mobile dependency risk for property technology and connectivity assessments
sources.limitations: Device-transition guidance is contextual and does not identify current broadband availability

sources.name: New gigabit address checker launch
sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology / Building Digital UK
sources.coverage: England and Wales address-level government-backed broadband upgrade lookup service announced 13 March 2026
sources.update_cadence: Service intended to track changing government/commercial upgrade plans
sources.access: GOV.UK service announcement and linked address checker
sources.role: Address-level indicator of current or planned government-backed gigabit upgrade status
sources.limitations: Announcement is not the underlying premises dataset and checker results can change with OMR/contract updates

sources.name: Project Gigabit: UK gigabit programme
sources.coverage: Government programme rules, gigabit-capable definition, voucher route and hard-to-reach rollout context
sources.limitations: Programme guidance is not a live parcel availability dataset; address or UPRN sources should decide parcel status
